note: Listing caps. Rust: rust/market-domain/src/limits.rs, the one definition every enforcement point imports. Browser: frontend/src/domain/limits.ts, which exists only so the UI can reject an out-of-range value before the round trip. Rust is the source of truth, so drift shows up as the UI accepting a batch the app then rejects - max_platinum was already raised from 999 once, after it silently blocked maxed Arcanes and Galvanized mods that really sell for 1500-2500p.
